result.title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
result.summary: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular, hackable, and easy to plug-and-play for individuals and teams.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告介绍 Taxi，一个面向大规模 agent 轨迹的调试、聚类与监控系统：用聚类为步骤生成分类法以获得结构化概览，并开放 SQL 供工程师或自动化 agent 查询，二者由编码 agent 串成混合流程；还实验性集成了把状态与有界问题直接映射为带类型概率决策的决策模型，用于低成本语义路由与评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按步骤聚类加查询的轨迹分析管线、以及「状态→有界问题的概率决策」建模，可能为考察 latent 推理轨迹的结构、停止决策与贡献分配提供诊断与评估工具线索，但论文本身并非研究视觉推理，需核查其分析粒度能否覆盖内部状态。
